body:
## Objective
Make PortfolioReceipt independently re-verifiable from its cited cashflow ledger file.

## Owning authority
- V8 Constitution (evidence-bound completion; no VERIFIED claim without machine receipts).
- Root AGENTS.md; .hermes.md s4.

## Change class
DEFECT_FIX

## Current state / Observed defect
`.audit/economic-cashflow.jsonl` holds 107 rows but `.audit/portfolio_receipt.json` claims n_trades_admitted=106, net_profit_usdt=+56.0016. Row 0 is a stale SOLUSDT trade (CAMP_SOLUSDT_67_L, event 2025-06-18, net +15.5987) from an older run; rows 1..106 are the BTCUSDT run whose wallet chain restarts at 1000.00 (chain break: row0 ends 1015.5987 -> row1 starts 1000.0). Summing the receipt's cited file gives net +71.6003, overstating the receipt by +15.5987 USDT (+27.8%). Rows 1..106 alone reproduce receipt net/fee/funding to 1e-9. Root cause is code, not data: `CashflowLedger::write_jsonl` (v8-core/src/cashflow.rs:134) opens with `.append(true)` and never truncates or tags run_id, so reusing an out_dir merges runs; the receipt binds the ledger only by filename (`cashflow_ledger_path`) with no row-count and no ledger digest (receipt keys verified: no hash/count field).

## Required end state / Expected behavior
A receipt consumer can reproduce receipt net/fee totals exactly from the cited ledger file, and a rerun into a reused out_dir cannot silently contaminate it.

## Expected file / module surface
v8-core/src/cashflow.rs (`write_jsonl`); v8-core/src/usdm_sim.rs (receipt construction ~1007-1033); .audit/economic-cashflow.jsonl; .audit/portfolio_receipt.json.

## Verification gates
G2 determinism/ledger; economic-evaluator acceptance. Acceptance: `sum(net_pnl_usdt over cited file) == receipt.net_profit_usdt` exactly on current artifacts after fix, plus a regression test rerunning into a reused out_dir. No full backtest needed.

## Required evidence artifacts
Fixed writer/binding commit; regression test receipt-vs-file reconciliation; re-verification numbers on the current .audit pair.
